scope: Bounded G2 case exact-marker and aligned-vector discovery; instruction-backed resolution of the vector-like pair at raw offset 0x6A18.
confirmed: The locked case payload has a 32-byte EVEN wrapper and 55,752-byte raw flash image; stored length and big-endian additive checksum match the raw image.
The exact known-marker scan has no raw-image hits for EVEN, FWPK, BINH, 0x7F454C46 (ELF), MZ or FWMH.

The aligned heuristic finds a primary vector at raw offset 0 and a second vector-like pair at raw 0x6A18. The latter is a 12-word PC-relative literal pool with two independently checked Thumb LDR load sites, not a separate vector table.
limits: Exact marker and aligned-word heuristics cannot exclude markerless, transformed or undocumented nested programs.
No whole-image reference or code/data sweep, canonical G1 admission, complete pseudocode, source completion or byte identity.
